Table of the market listings

Source: R/fct_plots.R
listings_table.Rd

A sortable table with 100 rows per page and numbers rounded to 2 decimals, showing the price in dollars and the price changes in percent. Losses are shaded red and gains green, more strongly the larger the change, in steps of 0.1 percentile from the 5th to the 95th. Changes near zero keep the table's own background, so the table suits the light and the dark mode.

Usage

listings_table(listings)

Arguments

listings

The data of get_listings().

Value

A DT datatable.

Examples

listings_table(get_listings()$data)
